investigation_notes.Description: Vitalis Healthcare was mentioned in an external document hosted on Scribd that contains internal VPN configuration details and references to sensitive network infrastructure. The content includes a VPN gateway address (10.45.2.112), a primary domain controller, and a secondary failover pathway, as well as a local certificate path, revealing internal network layout. Given the public exposure of this internal information and the potential for misuse, this alert warrants high-priority investigation.
